measurable_change.description: The City of Laredo WIC program permanently closed its La Ladrillera clinic at 2100 Pinder Avenue effective August 1, 2026. Local reporting says the closure was attributed to budget constraints and low attendance. Six other Laredo WIC clinics remain open, so the change reduces geographic WIC access without eliminating WIC service citywide.
measurable_change.measurement: effective closure date: 2026-08-01; clinic address: 2100 Pinder Avenue, Laredo, Texas; reported average monthly attendance: 55; other laredo wic clinics remaining open: 6

event_assessment.service: WIC nutrition-benefit access through the La Ladrillera clinic.

causal.note: The reviewed sources do not quantify how many current households were transferred to specific alternate clinics, the added travel time for each participant, whether any participants discontinued WIC because of the closure, or whether remaining clinics have absorbed the displaced caseload without delays.
